How to Apply

  1. Visit the official MPSC Online portal: mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in
  2. Log in using your own registered candidate account.
  3. Locate the admit card download section for your applied post/exam.
  4. Download the admit card within the download duration specified for your post in the table above.
  5. Keep a printed copy of the admit card ready for the examination.
